name: ci-budget
description: Keeps GitHub Actions spend in sight: the month's minutes and cost for the repo's organisation or account, GitHub budgets, cache and artifacts, risky workflows as they are written, and runs that hang

warnAt.title: Warn at (% of included minutes)
warnAt.description: A toast when the owner's usage crosses each of these percentages

blockAt.title: Block gh workflow run at (%)
blockAt.description: Deny `gh workflow run` from this share of the included minutes (billing data only); 0 never blocks

includedMinutes.title: Included minutes
includedMinutes.description: Minutes included per month; 0 takes them from the owner's plan (Free 2000, Pro and Team 3000, Enterprise 50000)

stuckMinutes.title: A job is stuck after (minutes)
stuckMinutes.description: While watching the runs of a push, warn about a job running longer than this

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often usage is read again during a session

lint.title: Check workflows as they are written
lint.description: Flag spend risks when a .github/workflows file is written or edited

watch.title: Watch runs after a push
watch.description: Follow the runs a git push or gh workflow run starts and flag stuck jobs
